correctness.rationale: The PDE coefficients generate the explicit real 4x4 modal matrix. Exact determinant factorization yields p_q(z)=((z+A)(z+E))^2+(z+E-gq)^2 with A=2+3q/10 and E=1+3q. Imaginary crossings are uniquely determined by the positive root of omega^2+omega=AE and have strictly positive d(Re z)/dg. The resulting exact critical gains are g1=(85+189 sqrt(105))/100 for q=1 and g2=(55+72 sqrt(205))/50 for q=2. For every q>=2, 0<=g<g2, positivity of the first three quartic coefficients, constant term and both Hurwitz minors follows from exact algebra and concavity of H(q,g) between endpoints 0 and g2; the upper endpoint factors as an explicit polynomial in q-2 with nonnegative coefficients and a unique zero at q=2. The square Neumann spectrum has no eigenvalue between 1 and 2, giving the exhaustive count. Verification from the exact package path used SymPy 1.14.0. This proves only linear spectral assertions.

value.rationale: A structurally natural balanced two-chemical coupling family has a sharp and complete first-harmonic instability interval, bounded by two computable algebraic gain thresholds. The theorem distinguishes oscillatory wave-type onset from stationary Turing criteria, classifies every spatial Neumann mode without numerical truncation and gives a rigorous target for studying nonlinear mode interactions near the double spatial eigenvalue. The fact is not a routine numeric recomputation of a table; the equal-coupling symmetry yields a new exact sum-of-squares spectral factorization and an all-mode polynomial certificate.
